+    def test_hook_generator(self):
+        """
+        field_transfromers can be a generators.
+
+        Regression test for #1416.
+        """
+
+        def hook(cls, attribs):
+            yield from attribs
+
+        @attr.s(auto_attribs=True, field_transformer=hook)
+        class Base:
+            x: int
+
+        assert ["x"] == [a.name for a in attr.fields(Base)]
